description: This file defines a final class `HeaderSecurity` within the `Laminas\Diactoros` namespace, providing static methods for security-related operations on HTTP headers, such as filtering and validating header values for injection prevention.

classes.name: HeaderSecurity
classes.description: Provides static utility methods for filtering and validating HTTP header values to prevent common injection vectors.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Sanitizes a header value by removing disallowed characters and sequences, ensuring it adheres to RFC 7230 for header safety.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates a header value to ensure it does not contain illegal or dangerous characters or sequences, according to RFC 7230.

methods.name: assertValid
methods.description: Asserts that a header value is valid; throws an exception if invalid.

methods.name: assertValidName
methods.description: Checks if a header name is valid according to RFC 7230 token rules; throws an exception if invalid.
